description: The classic quests and our own (Market Closed, MKTCLOSE, and the political quests a seat's questgivers offer from the live board: POLWORD, POLTURN and POLUNDER): one record per quest in quests/ (its messages and QBN blocks), the classic quest list, the quest tables and the corpora that say how each quest is offered, and in worldVariants the location variants a quest's world update selects with the block-variant recipes they draw, whose block documents and collision are baked into variants/ by daggerfall-source-tool world-variant-bake (run it after editing a recipe). Taken once from Daggerfall Unity's quest scripts and tables (Assets/StreamingAssets/Quests and Tables, MIT, commit 81e89e90c27bc3c1a7a61871e545fad129174dec), themselves Daggerfall's quests by Bethesda Softworks; edited here in place.
